requirements.text: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program in Computer Science, EECS, Robotics, AI, or a closely related field
Coursework, project experience, or research background in at least one core domain: Generative World Models / Video Generation / Diffusion Models
Coursework, project experience, or research background in at least one core domain: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models or embodied AI
Coursework, project experience, or research background in at least one core domain: Reinforcement Learning (RL), trajectory optimization, or decision-making systems
Coursework, project experience, or research background in at least one core domain: Large-scale multimodal Transformer architectures applied to robotics or spatio-temporal data
Advanced hands-on proficiency with PyTorch or JAX for training and fine-tuning large-scale neural networks
Prior research, project, or internship experience in autonomous driving, mobile robotics, or spatial AI
